description: Source code for various hardware control and management functions for a Linux kernel driver related to a PCIe endpoint, including clock management, interrupt handling, GPIO configuration, and pin multiplexing.

methods.name: void dc_ep_clkod_disable(struct dc_ep_priv * priv)
methods.description: Disables the clock output for the PCIe endpoint.

methods.name: void dc_ep_icu_init(struct dc_ep_priv * priv)
methods.description: Initializes the Interrupt Control Unit (ICU) for PCIe MSI interrupts.

methods.name: void dc_ep_icu_disable(struct dc_ep_priv * priv)
methods.description: Disables all PCIe-related interrupts in the ICU.

methods.name: void dc_ep_icu_dis_intr(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 bits)
methods.description: Disables specific ICU interrupts based on provided bits.

methods.name: void dc_ep_icu_en_intr(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 bits)
methods.description: Enables specific ICU interrupts based on provided bits.

methods.name: void dc_ep_assert_device(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 bits)
methods.description: Asserts (requests) specific bits for the device via RCU request register.

methods.name: void dc_ep_deassert_device(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 bits)
methods.description: Deasserts (releases) specific bits for the device via RCU request register.

methods.name: int dc_ep_reset_device(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 bits)
methods.description: Resets the device by setting bits and waiting for status acknowledgment.

methods.name: int dc_ep_clk_on(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 bits)
methods.description: Enables clock(s) for the device with retries.

methods.name: int dc_ep_clk_off(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 bits)
methods.description: Disables clock(s) for the device with retries.

methods.name: int dc_ep_clk_set(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 sysclk,u32 ppeclk)
methods.description: Sets the system clock and PPE clock frequencies.

methods.name: int dc_ep_clk_get(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 * sysclk,u32 * ppeclk)
methods.description: Gets the current system clock and PPE clock frequencies.

methods.name: int dc_ep_gpio_dir(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 gpio,int dir)
methods.description: Configures GPIO direction (input or output).

methods.name: int dc_ep_gpio_set(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 gpio,int val)
methods.description: Sets GPIO output value.

methods.name: int dc_ep_gpio_get(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 gpio,int * val)
methods.description: Reads GPIO input value.

methods.name: int dc_ep_pinmux_set(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 gpio,int func)
methods.description: Configures pin multiplexing for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: int dc_ep_pinmux_get(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 gpio,int * func)
methods.description: Retrieves pin multiplexing setting for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: int dc_ep_gpio_pupd_set(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 gpio,u32 val)
methods.description: Configures GPIO pull-up/pull-down resistors.

methods.name: int dc_ep_gpio_od_set(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 gpio,int val)
methods.description: Sets GPIO open-drain configuration.

methods.name: int dc_ep_gpio_src_set(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 gpio,int val)
methods.description: Configures GPIO source.

methods.name: int dc_ep_gpio_dcc_set(struct dc_ep_priv * priv,u32 gpio,u32 val)
methods.description: Sets the drive strength of GPIO.
